trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6362444.

Local resolver metadata identified zbMATH 6362444 as the DOI-linked work 'Broyden's quasi-Newton methods for a nonlinear system of equations and unconstrained optimization: a review and open problems' with DOI 10.1080/10556788.2013.856909.

Failure mode: metadata_only and paywalled_or_restricted, with network_or_dns_failure in the local CLI fetch path. The zbMATH record was not readable through the page-reading tool, shell curl to api.zbmath.org failed DNS resolution in the restricted environment, and zbMATH/OAI/API discovery exposed only resolver/help or terms pages rather than a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source.
evidence_refs: curl: (6) Could not resolve host: api.zbmath.org

trace.notes: Bounded recovery attempts used the exact DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus filetype:pdf, exact title plus authors, and local OpenAlex/DBLP metadata. Candidate pages were rejected because Taylor & Francis exposed a publisher landing/abstract page, ResearchGate reported no full text, Sultan Qaboos/Pure and OpenAlex/DBLP were metadata records, and the Aisberg repository listed only a manager-only restricted PDF attachment.
